items.description: South Devon coast from Start Point to Dawlish Warren
items.eaAreaName: Devon, Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly
items.message:
There is no longer a threat of flooding, though standing water and debris may still remain.
Coastal conditions are expected to improve and no flooding is expected.  
We will continue to monitor the situation and will issue further alerts or warnings if necessary.  
Continue to take care on waterside roads and footpaths and don't put yourself in unnecessary danger.

High tides and forecast weather conditions tomorrow morning may lead to flooding.
Flooding is possible from 07:45-09:00 on 26/11/2026.
Locations most affected will be coastal roads and footpaths on the North Sea coast from Bridlington to Barmston. Tides will remain high with on-shore winds for the next few days meaning coastal flooding will remain possible.
We are closely monitoring the situation.
Avoid beaches and coastal promenades, which may be flooded. 
This message will be updated by 9:00AM on Thursday 26th November or as the situation changes.

items.description: North Sea coast at Withernsea, Easington and Kilnsea
items.message:
High tides and forecast weather conditions tomorrow morning may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 05:30 to 08:30 on 26/11/2026. 
Locations most affected will be coastal roads and footpaths on the North Sea coast along Spurn Road. 
We are closely monitoring the situation. 
Avoid beaches and coastal promenades, which may be flooded. 
This message will be updated by 9:00AM on Thursday 26th November or as the situation changes.

items.description: River Hayle from Relubbus to St Erth
items.eaAreaName: Devon, Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly
items.message:
The Flood Warning has now been removed. However, a Flood Alert remains in force for the wider area, so flooding of roads and low lying land is still possible.
Weather conditions are expected to improve.  
We will continue to monitor the situation and will issue further alerts or warnings if necessary.  
Continue to take care on waterside roads and footpaths and don't put yourself in unnecessary danger.
